label: LOCAL DRAFT TEMPLATE CATALOG - NO TEMPLATE IS APPROVED. Safety and clinical-boundary text are neutral placeholders pending the clinical safety lead; recording, consent and disclosure text are placeholders pending privacy counsel; Spanish text is pending native-speaker review. SYNTHETIC / LOCAL USE ONLY.

templates.text: You have reached {companyName}. I'm an automated support assistant. I can help with scheduling, billing, and account questions. You can ask for a person at any time.

metadata.purpose: Opening: identifies the company and the automated support role and offers a human (spec section 11 template).
metadata.notes: Text is the spec section 11 template. It must be followed by the approved consent flow (recording.consent_question); it is not a substitute for it. Company name is a SYNTHETIC placeholder value.

templates.text: This call may be recorded, and it is processed by automated systems to help with your request. Do you agree to continue? Please say yes or no.

metadata.purpose: Recording and processing consent question, asked before recording where required.
metadata.notes: Placeholder wording. Counsel must confirm accuracy per jurisdiction (what records, what processes, retention).

templates.text: Understood. I won't continue with the automated assistant. I'm connecting you with a person.

metadata.purpose: Approved alternative when the caller declines recording or automated processing.
metadata.notes: Must never claim the call is unrecorded unless counsel confirms every recorder, transcription and model process stops.

templates.text: I'm an automated assistant, and this conversation is processed by automated systems.

metadata.purpose: Automated-processing disclosure.

templates.text: Are you calling as a client, a provider, or a partner?

metadata.purpose: Role selection (one question at a time; a multi-role user selects one role).

templates.text: To protect your information, I use a secure link. If the details match an account, a link has been sent to the contact method already on file. Please open it to continue.

metadata.purpose: Secure link verification prompt. Generic: identical for zero, one or many matches (no account-existence disclosure).
metadata.notes: GENERIC_STATUS on purpose: spoken at A0 before any account is located and reveals nothing.

templates.text: To protect your information, I use a secure link. If the details match an account, a link has been sent to the contact method already on file. When you open it, check that it shows the words {matchCode} before you approve.

metadata.purpose: Secure link verification prompt with the two-word match code the portal shows (explicit transaction matching, spec section 7). Generic: identical for zero, one or many matches.
metadata.notes: The match code is generated for every request, eligible or not, so it reveals nothing about account existence; it is not a secret and grants nothing (identity/match-code.ts). Pending support operations and identity owner review.

templates.text: If the details match an account, a one-time code has been sent to the phone number already on file. Please don't say the code out loud. Enter it only when the secure prompt asks for it.

metadata.purpose: One-time code prompt (only if policy permits OTP fallback). Generic; tells the caller not to speak the code (AUTH-06).
metadata.notes: OTP fallback stays disabled until isolated DTMF capture is proven (TB-03).

templates.text: I wasn't able to complete verification. I can connect you with a person who can help.

metadata.purpose: Verification failed. Generic: no account-existence disclosure.

templates.text: Thank you, {displayName}. You're verified for this call.

metadata.purpose: Confirms verification for this call using the verified display name.

templates.text: I have the name {name}. Is that right?

metadata.purpose: Confirms a name by spelling it.

templates.text: Let me check that.

metadata.purpose: Safe acknowledgment while a tool runs. Never counts as resolution or as resolution latency.

templates.text: Would you like me to connect you with a person?

metadata.purpose: Offers a human.

templates.text: I'm connecting you with a person now. Please stay on the line.

metadata.purpose: Transfer in progress.

templates.text: That connection didn't go through. I'm trying the next available person now. Please stay on the line.

metadata.purpose: Transfer attempt failed; the next staffed route is being tried. The call is never ended.

templates.text: I'm still connecting you with a person. Please stay on the line.

metadata.purpose: Update while a safety-priority connection is still being established or retried.
metadata.notes: Neutral procedural placeholder, not clinical guidance. The clinical safety lead owns the approved script.

templates.text: I'm connecting you with a person right now. Please stay on the line.

metadata.purpose: Fixed acknowledgment on a credible or unresolved safety concern before priority human connection.
metadata.notes: Neutral procedural placeholder, not clinical guidance. The clinical safety lead owns the approved script. Renders at A0 without authorization (SAFE-02).

templates.text: I can't answer health or treatment questions. I can connect you with someone who can help with that.

metadata.purpose: Concise boundary statement for diagnosis, medication, therapy or screening questions, followed by the clinician/human route.
metadata.notes: Neutral placeholder; gives no diagnostic, therapeutic or medication content (SAFE-01).

templates.text: One moment. I'm connecting you with an interpreter.

metadata.purpose: Routing to the staffed interpreter path.

templates.text: I can't help in that language. I'm connecting you with an interpreter now.

metadata.purpose: Unsupported language; routes to the interpreter path.

templates.text: Some automated services are unavailable right now. I'm connecting you with our support team.

metadata.purpose: Outage / budget-exhaustion continuity message before the approved continuity route. Makes no wait-time promise.

templates.text: Your appointment with {providerName} is on {date} at {time}, {timeZone}.

metadata.purpose: Own appointment facts from the authoritative scheduling source.

templates.text: To confirm, I'll move your {fromModality} appointment from {fromDate} at {fromTime}, {fromTimeZone}, to {toDate} at {toTime}, {toTimeZone}, as {toModality}. Say yes to confirm, or no to keep it.

metadata.purpose: Confirmation question bound to a prepared appointment change (dates, times, time zones and the visit type before and after are read back before commit).
metadata.notes: ACT-F5: every caller-relevant field of the digest-bound change is read back (visit type, provider of a new booking, review reason).

templates.text: I've submitted your request. It isn't complete yet, and our team will follow up. Your support reference is {supportReference}.

metadata.purpose: Request accepted and pending work. Never says resolved or done (ACT-04).

templates.text: Your confirmation code is {confirmationCode}.

metadata.purpose: Reads back a committed change's confirmation code by spelling it.

templates.text: Your support reference is {supportReference}. This is a support reference that is still being synchronized. It is not a case number.

metadata.purpose: Internal support reference while the CRM record is pending synchronization; not an invented case number.

templates.text: Your current balance is {amount}, due on {dueDate}.

metadata.purpose: Invoice balance from authoritative billing fields (integer minor units).
metadata.notes: Explanation only: no coverage decision, fee waiver or refund promise.

templates.text: The charge for {serviceDate} is {amount}, for {lineType}.

metadata.purpose: One invoice line from authoritative fields.
metadata.notes: Explanation only: no coverage decision, fee waiver or refund promise.

templates.text: Your claim for the service on {serviceDate} shows an insurer status of {insurerStatus}, as of {asOfDate}. This is the insurer's status. It is not a guarantee of payment.

metadata.purpose: Insurer claim status; explicitly not an eligibility or payment guarantee.

templates.text: The remittance for {periodStart} through {periodEnd} has a status of {remittanceStatus}, with a total of {amount}.

metadata.purpose: Remittance status for an authorized practice.

templates.text: Your onboarding stage is {stage}. Documents still needed: {missingCount}.

metadata.purpose: Provider onboarding status.

templates.text: In the portal, go to {portalPath}.

metadata.purpose: Public portal navigation guidance (no credential reset, no password requests).

templates.text: I can't help with that on this call. I can connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: Generic policy denial; reveals nothing about records or accounts.

templates.text: Sure. I'll repeat that.

metadata.purpose: Repeat on request (access rules unchanged).

templates.text: Of course. I'll speak more slowly.

metadata.purpose: Slower speech on request (access rules unchanged).

templates.text: I'm still here. Take your time. You can also ask for a person.

metadata.purpose: Silence check-in; never a hang-up.

templates.text: I can't complete that right now. I'll connect you with a person who can help.

metadata.purpose: Gate fallback: safe explanation plus human route when proof is missing (fail closed).

templates.text: The next open time is {date} at {time}, {timeZone}. Would you like that time?

metadata.purpose: Offers one open administrative time from the scheduling system for the authorized subject (no clinical matching). Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I don't see an open time in that range. I can check other dates, or connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: No open time in the requested range. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: To confirm, I'll book {modality} with {providerName} on {date} at {time}, {timeZone}. Say yes to confirm, or no to cancel.

metadata.purpose: Confirmation question bound to a prepared appointment booking (visit type, provider, date, time and time zone read back before commit). Added by the business layer (wave 2).
metadata.notes: ACT-F5: every caller-relevant field of the digest-bound change is read back (visit type, provider of a new booking, review reason).

templates.text: Your appointment is now on {date} at {time}, {timeZone}.

metadata.purpose: Spoken only from a COMMITTED commit receipt for appointment.reschedule. Added by the business layer (wave 2).
metadata.notes: Never used for a pending, failed or unknown outcome (ACT-03).

templates.text: Your new appointment is booked for {date} at {time}, {timeZone}.

metadata.purpose: Spoken only from a COMMITTED commit receipt for appointment.create. Added by the business layer (wave 2).
metadata.notes: Never used for a pending, failed or unknown outcome (ACT-03).

templates.text: That time was just taken, so nothing was changed. The next open time is {date} at {time}, {timeZone}. Would you like that time instead?

metadata.purpose: Slot conflict at commit: nothing changed; offers the next authoritative open time. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: That time was just taken, so nothing was changed. I can look for other times, or connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: Slot conflict at commit with no other open time in the window. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: Your appointment changed since we started, so nothing was changed yet. Let me check the current details again.

metadata.purpose: Optimistic-concurrency conflict: the prepared change is invalidated and must be prepared again. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I couldn't confirm whether that change went through, so I won't try it again until it's checked. I can connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: Ambiguous commit outcome (UNKNOWN): never announced as success and never retried before reconciliation (ACT-03). Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: To confirm, I'll submit a billing review for the invoice issued on {issuedDate}, because {reasonCategory}. A review does not change your balance unless our team completes it with a change. Say yes to confirm, or no to cancel.

labels.CHARGE_NOT_RECOGNIZED: you do not recognize the charge
labels.LATE_CANCELLATION_FEE_DISPUTE: you are disputing a late cancellation fee
labels.NO_SHOW_FEE_DISPUTE: you are disputing a missed appointment fee
labels.INSURANCE_SHOULD_HAVE_PAID: you believe insurance should have paid

metadata.purpose: Confirmation question bound to a prepared billing review: the invoice and the review reason the action carries are read back. States that a review is not a change to the balance (ACT-04). Added by the business layer (wave 2).
metadata.notes: No refund, waiver or coverage wording. ACT-F5: every caller-relevant field of the digest-bound change is read back (visit type, provider of a new booking, review reason).

templates.text: You can pay on our secure payment page or in the portal. For your protection, I can't take card numbers on this call.

metadata.purpose: Directs to the approved hosted payment page; card data is never collected by voice. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: There isn't an open balance I can send you to pay right now. I can connect you with a person if you have a question about it.

metadata.purpose: No OPEN invoice with a balance; no payment path is offered. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I've submitted your request. It isn't complete yet, and our team will follow up. Your support reference is {supportReference}. It is still being synchronized and is not a case number.

metadata.purpose: Request accepted with an internal support reference pending synchronization; never says resolved (ACT-04). Added by the business layer (wave 2).
metadata.notes: Never presented as a Salesforce Case number (spec section 8).

templates.text: I've submitted your request. It isn't complete yet, and our team will follow up.

metadata.purpose: Request accepted when the support reference is not yet available (reconciliation pending). Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: Your request {supportReference} is {caseStatus}.

metadata.purpose: Status of the authorized caller's own support request. A created request is not a resolution (ACT-04). Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I see an open request with reference {supportReference}, about {issueCategory}. Are you calling about that request?

labels.clinical_question_redirected: a question for our care team

metadata.purpose: Repeat-caller recap from support memory, only after A2 authentication of the same subject (DATA-04). Added by the business layer (wave 2).
metadata.notes: Never spoken before authentication or on a shared device.

templates.text: I couldn't find an open request I can share on this call. I can create a new request, or connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: No shareable request; reveals nothing about other records. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I can't reset passwords or take a password by phone. On the sign-in page, choose the account recovery option, or I can connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: Portal sign-in guidance: never resets credentials or asks for a password; directs to the identity provider's own recovery. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: Account recovery has to go through our secure recovery process. I can connect you with a person who can help.

metadata.purpose: Lockout or lost MFA device: trusted human recovery process. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: Documents still needed: {missingCount}. One of them is {documentType}.

metadata.purpose: Credentialing document status from the provider record; never a credentialing decision. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I don't have approved information about that. I can connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: No approved knowledge item matched; nothing is improvised. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: I don't see a record I can share on this call. I can connect you with a person.

metadata.purpose: Empty authorized lookup; reveals nothing about other records. Added by the business layer (wave 2).

templates.text: The remittance for {periodStart} through {periodEnd}, with a total of {amount}, was returned. I can connect you with our provider support team.

metadata.purpose: Returned remittance for an authorized practice; routes to provider relations. Added by the business layer (wave 2).
